verdict.rationale: Dagster does not ship its own connector catalog in the evidence. It reaches SaaS, database and file sources indirectly through maintained integration libraries for Airbyte, Fivetran and dlt, whose connectors are represented as Dagster assets, plus a dbt integration for transformation. Breadth of coverage therefore depends on running those extra tools alongside Dagster. Missing for 10: a native Dagster connector catalog, evidence of how many sources it covers (SaaS, databases, files), and independent hands-on corroboration of connector quality.
